items.exampleEn: Let's talk it over after lunch.
Take a few days to think it over.
Turn the pancake over when small bubbles appear.
items.exampleZh: 等表面出現小氣泡時，就把鬆餅翻面。

items.exampleEn: Sorry, the milk is all used up.
Cheap tires wear out quickly on mountain roads.
items.exampleZh: 便宜的輪胎在山路上很快就會磨損。

items.exampleEn: The farm made good profits for years, but one bad season wiped them out.
items.exampleZh: 這座農場好幾年都賺得不錯，但一個不好的季節就讓利潤全沒了。

items.exampleEn: Scientists are working on a cleaner kind of fuel.
items.exampleZh: 科學家正在研發一種更乾淨的燃料。

items.sentenceEn: Who used the hot water up this morning?
items.sentenceZh: 今天早上是誰把熱水都用完了？

items.audioEn: The job offer sounds great, but I need to think it over before I give them an answer.
items.audioZh: 這個工作機會聽起來很棒，但我得仔細考慮過再給他們答覆。
items.questionZh: 說話者目前對這個工作機會的決定是什麼？
options: Will accept it right away and start soon
Will turn it down because the pay is low
Has already said yes to it

items.sentenceEn: Long meetings always wear me out.
items.sentenceZh: 冗長的會議總是讓我筋疲力盡。

items.sentenceEn: My parents talked over the plan with my teacher.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸媽和我的老師商量了這個計畫。

items.stemEn: Our team is ____ a new design for the company's website.
items.stemZh: 我們團隊正在處理公司網站的新設計。

items.stemEn: The man ____ the wallet he found in the street to the police.
items.stemZh: 那位男士把在街上撿到的皮夾交給了警察。

items.passageEn: Every Saturday, students in our school's bike club work on old bicycles that people no longer use. Many of the bikes have flat tires and broken lights. Last month, the club used up all its money on new parts, so the members talked over what to do next. A week later, they decided to sell some of the repaired bikes at a low price. The money will help them buy more parts, and more students in town will be able to ride to school.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六，我們學校腳踏車社的學生會修理大家不再使用的舊腳踏車。很多車的輪胎沒氣、車燈壞了。上個月，社團把所有的錢都花在新零件上，所以社員們商量接下來該怎麼辦。一週後，他們決定把一些修好的腳踏車便宜賣掉。賣得的錢能幫他們買更多零件，鎮上也會有更多學生能騎車上學。

questions.questionZh: 社團上個月遇到什麼問題？
options: 很多同學退出了腳踏車社

questions.questionZh: 賣腳踏車的錢要做什麼？

items.promptZh: 這雙鞋我穿了三年，已經磨壞了。
referenceEn: I've worn these shoes for three years, and they've worn out.
After three years, these shoes have worn out.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「磨壞」（例如 have worn out、are worn out 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 are worn、are falling apart 等）
時態可用現在完成式或過去式（例如 have worn out、wore out 等）
「穿了三年」可寫，例如 I've worn them for three years、after three years 等

items.promptZh: 對手在最後一分鐘進球，讓我們的領先化為烏有。
referenceEn: The other team's goal in the last minute wiped out our lead.
Their last-minute goal wiped out our lead.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「讓…化為烏有」（例如 wiped out our lead 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 erased our lead、cancelled out our lead、tied the game 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 wiped out、has wiped out 等）
「最後一分鐘的進球」可寫，例如 a goal in the last minute、a last-minute goal 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：FIX：干擾項「擦拭」「打掃乾淨」是 wipe out 的字面義（§13.1），換成同小品詞片語的意思
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["擦拭","打掃乾淨","丟掉"]；改後：["磨損","逐步淘汰","用完"]

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：可分離片語 wipe out 補受詞放中間的寫法（裁示 2）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："One bad season wiped out the small farm's profits."；改後："One bad season wiped the farm's profits out."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：FIX：「歉收」是原文沒有的資訊（§11.20）
